name: operator
wording: The person who states intent and its priorities, releases, and holds sign-off, exercised at the gates that reach it and only there: a story's read-back, a story's plan read-back, a pull request it reviews, release, a fork that is irreversible, about value or beyond the architect's competence, and any gate it calls, stop included. It is the client of the principal architect in an engagement where each is sovereign in its own domain. It joins the session of whichever party holds a gate, so the technical colour it adds at the plan reaches the lead directly and never passes through the architect. Between gates the agents work without checking in, and by delegated authority it may take itself out of the loop, its delegated sign-offs taken in its place.
reason: The operator was asked nothing between stating intent and release, which left no point where an agent waits on it; it now signs off at the gates that reach it, and only there.
